publication.title: [v0.92.2][C-SDLC] Reconcile interrupted reserved proof outcomes
publication.body:
Closes #980

## Summary
- reconcile repeated explicit abandoned proof recovery as an expected no-op
- preserve retry behavior for interrupted proof attempts
- add focused semantic proof regression coverage

## Validation
- cargo test --manifest-path csdlc-v3/Cargo.toml --test semantic_local_proof prelaunch_proof_interruption_requires_exact_explicit_disposition
- cargo test --manifest-path csdlc-v3/Cargo.toml --test semantic_local_proof interrupted_proof_is_explicitly_abandoned_without_rerun_and_can_retry
- cargo fmt --manifest-path csdlc-v3/Cargo.toml --check
- cargo check --manifest-path csdlc-v3/Cargo.toml
